Chess Assist v28.5 - background service worker (original file: extension/assets/rgn.js)

Readable version generated by my deobfuscation pipeline (tools/). Reference only; not loaded.

Role: the only piece of the extension that holds the powerful "debugger" permission.
The content script cannot click on the page with trusted events by itself, so it asks
this worker to attach the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) to the tab and dispatch
real mouse presses/releases. That is how AUTOPLAY makes moves.

Messages it understands (sent with chrome.runtime.sendMessage from the content script):
  "lga-datas-atch"                 -> attach the debugger to the sender's tab (protocol 1.3)
  "lga-datas-dtch"                 -> detach the debugger from every attached page
  {val0:"lga-datas-snmd", val1:"p"|"r", val2:x, val3:y}
                                   -> Input.dispatchMouseEvent mousePressed / mouseReleased at (x, y)

comments.chrome.debugger.onDetach.addListener:
If the user closes the yellow "started debugging this browser" bar (or the tab), Chrome
detaches the debugger. Autoplay can no longer click, so switch it off in storage.
comments.chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener: Message bus from the content script (assets/tne.js).
